reverse_logistics_mgr.role: EV Battery Second-Life Diagnostics, Black Mass Recycling & Warranty Remanufacturing
reverse_logistics_mgr.summary: Orchestrates reverse logistics for degraded or recalled high-voltage battery packs, electric drive motors, and dealer warranty cores.

demand_sensing_agent.systems: SAP S/4HANA Wolfsburg · Siemens Opcenter MES · PowerCo Cell ERP · EDI 830/852 Dealer Feeds · BigQuery · Vertex AI TimesFM
demand_sensing_agent.problemDetails: Monthly dealer order spreadsheets lack real-time visibility into electric vehicle (EV) trim-level take rates and battery capacity constraints, creating 6-week blindspots and assembly line imbalances.
demand_sensing_agent.solutionDetails: PulseCast continuously ingests vehicle configurator signals, dealer showroom reservation curves, and European dealer inventory into TimesFM with hierarchical trim and powertrain reconciliation (BEV vs. ICE).
demand_sensing_agent.outcomeDetails: Eliminates line starvation at Wolfsburg and Zwickau MEB plants; cuts finished vehicle lot dwell by 18 days (€42M in working capital freed).

mps_finite_scheduler.systems: Siemens Opcenter MES · SAP PP/DS · KUKA Body Shop SCADA · OR-Tools CP-SAT
mps_finite_scheduler.problemDetails: Stamping press coil changeovers, paint shop color block flushes, and just-in-sequence (JIS) chassis line feeding are frequently derailed by late supplier sub-assemblies.
mps_finite_scheduler.solutionDetails: OR-Tools CP-SAT finite capacity job-shop solver sequences body-in-white stamping, paint shop color blocks, and final assembly line feeding to lock 100% material pegging 48 hours before body drop.
mps_finite_scheduler.outcomeDetails: Reduces paint shop solvent purge waste by 28%; cuts line changeover delays by 32% and prevents assembly line stops across global MEB gigafactories.

category_should_cost.systems: SAP Ariba · Siemens Teamcenter BOM · London Metal Exchange Feeds · BigQuery ML
category_should_cost.problemDetails: Surging prices and opaque supplier markups on lithium cathode active materials, battery modules, and microcontrollers inflate vehicle bill of materials (BOM) costs.
category_should_cost.solutionDetails: Decomposes Tier-1 automotive sub-assemblies into raw raw-material indices (LME nickel/cobalt, engineered plastics, stamping steel) and clean-sheet manufacturing cycle times.
category_should_cost.outcomeDetails: Saves €110M in annual powertrain and electronics procurement negotiations; establishes transparent should-cost price corridors across Tier-1 suppliers.

fleet_route_dispatch_optimizer.systems: SAP TM · Port of Emden Vehicle Logistics Portal · Google Maps Routes Preferred API · OR-Tools CVRPTW
fleet_route_dispatch_optimizer.problemDetails: Outbound vehicle logistics dispatchers manually assign finished cars to 9-car double-deck haulers, resulting in high deadhead return miles and vehicle bumper damage.
fleet_route_dispatch_optimizer.solutionDetails: Solves heterogeneous 3D vehicle hauler spatial loading combined with Google Maps corridor routing, synchronizing factory yard gate dispatches with European dealer compound deliveries.
fleet_route_dispatch_optimizer.outcomeDetails: Cuts empty return miles by 24%; improves dealer delivery on-time arrival to 98.6% and reduces in-transit vehicle scratches and damage claims by 40%.
